title: Puthoff says he consulted on the net assessment, with Hadley involved

tellings.quote: also Hal Putoff is on record saying he consulted for this net assessment. National security adviser Steven Hadley was involved

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a physicist named Harold Puthoff is on record saying he consulted on a government "net assessment", a big-picture strategic study, in Washington in the 2000s. Michels adds that Stephen Hadley, the US national security adviser, was involved. If true, it would mean people at the top of US national security were looking into unexplained phenomena.
